description: Measured llama.cpp throughput on the reference desktop, used by core.geoai.eval.estimate_desktop_latency to turn token counts from any benchmark run (e.g. a cloud GPU) into ESTIMATED desktop latency. Not a measurement of the run itself.

machine.name: reference laptop
machine.runtime: llama-cpp-python 0.3.35 (CPU wheel), n_threads 6 / n_threads_batch 12, n_batch 512, n_ctx 4096

qwen3-1.7b.notes: Prompt processing ~27 tok/s (17-31 with thermal throttling), generation 4-6 tok/s, measured 2026-10-04. model_load_s from benchmark run cpu-test40 (2026-09-28).

other_models: Models without an entry are scaled from the reference model by GGUF file size (throughput ~ 1/size); that is a rough estimate only.
